clue.text: Very happy to make broth

parts.note: very means so, as in so good
up means cheerful or happy, as in feeling up

explanation.surface: Someone is delighted to be cooking a pot of broth.
explanation.definitionFit: Broth is a thin liquid food, a kind of this dish served in a bowl.

clue.text: At home, stiff and weak

parts.note: at home means in, as in staying in
stiff means firm or rigid

explanation.surface: Someone stuck at home, their joints stiff and their body frail.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone frail and feeble through age or illness is weak.

clue.text: Giving rise to defeat in tie

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word is read from the bottom up, so backwards

parts.note: tonk is informal for beating or thrashing an opponent

explanation.surface: A tied match seems to be leading towards a loss.
explanation.walkthrough: TONK, slang for to defeat soundly, is turned upwards by 'Giving rise to'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a knot is a tie fastening rope or string together.

clue.text: Like a squirrel checking its tail in light fall of snow?

indicators.note: checking means holding back or restraining, so one piece is held inside the other

parts.note: a squirrel has a coat of fur, so it is furry
the tail of the word squirrel is its last letter, L

explanation.surface: A squirrel stops to inspect its bushy tail during a light snowfall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'its' points back to squirrel, whose last letter goes inside FURRY.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief light shower of snowflakes blown about is called a snow flurry.

clue.text: Weapon taken from section of ship under bridge

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed under another comes after it

parts.note: to bridge something is to cross it
the bow is the front part of a ship

explanation.surface: A weapon is taken from part of a ship, beneath its bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: A medieval bow mounted on a stock, firing bolts, is a classic missile weapon.

clue.text: Animated movie film a man shot about return of artist

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the anagram goes round the other piece
shot means wrecked or ruined, so these letters are broken up and rearranged
return means the word comes back the other way

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A man shoots a film about an artist coming back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Animated movie' is Orwell's fable as a 1954 cartoon; RA is a Royal Academician.
explanation.definitionFit: Orwell's farmyard fable was made into a British cartoon feature film in 1954.

clue.text: Performing boy creates strange events

parts.note: going means working or functioning, as a machine that is going
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A boy on stage is causing odd happenings.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: peculiar or suspicious happenings are described as carryings-on of that sort.

clue.text: Number in science lab initially producing copy

indicators.note: in means the number is placed inside the abbreviation

parts.note: ten is a number

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of lab

explanation.surface: A number in a science lab is copying something.
explanation.definitionFit: To reproduce a pattern by brushing through a cut-out template is to copy it this way.

clue.text: Body part of cat probed by a practitioner, ultimately

indicators.note: probed by means something is pushed into the cat word

parts.note: a lynx is a wild cat

indicators.note: ultimately means take the last letter of practitioner

explanation.surface: A vet examines part of a cat's body.
explanation.definitionFit: The voice box in the throat is an organ, so a part of the body.

clue.text: Fairy queen admitted to malice

indicators.note: admitted to means let into, so the queen goes inside

parts.note: spite means malice
R is the abbreviation for queen, from Regina

explanation.surface: A fairy queen confesses to having acted out of malice.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an elf or small mischievous spirit of folklore is a fairy.

clue.text: Boring book about anger and self-control, primarily

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the book word goes round the rest

parts.note: a tome is a large book
ire means anger

indicators.note: primarily means take the first letter of self-control

explanation.surface: A dull book about managing anger and keeping self-control.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something tedious and wearying is dull and boring.

clue.text: He, for example, in holy Mecca with limbs broken

definitions.note: He stands for helium in chemistry

indicators.note: broken means the letters are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: A man in holy Mecca with broken limbs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He' looks like a pronoun for a person, but it is the element helium's notation.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: He is the one- or two-letter notation for helium on the periodic table.

clue.text: Hit toy, toy I mistreated, being snobbish

indicators.note: mistreated means handled badly, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone hits and mistreats toys while acting superior.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: haughty, pretentious and stuck-up people are snobbish.

clue.text: Large Italian male, supple

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing labels
he is the male pronoun

explanation.surface: A big Italian man who is flexible.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a lissom, flexible, agile body is supple.

clue.text: There may be talk after this Fifties dance

definitions.text: There may be talk after this
definitions.meaning: ... talk is a slang of jazz musicians, so talk can follow the word
a lively jazz and rock and roll dance popular in the 1950s

explanation.surface: A 1950s dance that might be followed by conversation.
explanation.definitionFit: The energetic swing dance to rock and roll was the craze of the 1950s.

clue.text: Supplied key, then made a clever remark

parts.note: E is a musical key
to quip is to make a witty remark

explanation.surface: Someone handed over a key, then said something witty.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: provided or furnished with what is needed means supplied.

clue.text: Allowed out of bed? That's a relief

definitions.meaning: to be permitted to get up from bed
a pause or easing off, as in rain with no break

explanation.surface: A patient permitted to get out of bed sighs with relief.
explanation.definitionFit: A lessening or pause in something unpleasant brings relief.

clue.text: Peer, seeing a young man entering security number

indicators.note: entering means going into, so these pieces go inside

parts.note: a PIN is a personal identification number used for security
a lad is a young man

explanation.surface: A nobleman sees a youth typing in a security code.
explanation.walkthrough: Peer here is one of Charlemagne's twelve knights, not a person who looks.
explanation.definitionFit: Charlemagne's twelve legendary knights were his peers; the word now means a knightly champion.

clue.text: Cover Westlife's first hit

indicators.note: first means take the opening letter of Westlife

parts.note: a rap is a sharp blow or hit

explanation.surface: A cover version of the boy band Westlife's first hit single.
explanation.walkthrough: Westlife is an Irish boy band; 'hit' looks like a chart song but is a blow.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to enclose or envelop something is to cover it.

clue.text: Ordering again? Between the two of us, I couldn't agree more

indicators.note: between means the piece sits between the two words for us

parts.note: the two of us are you and me
to tell someone is to order them, so telling again is retelling

explanation.surface: Someone orders a second round, and confides in a friend that they agree.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: an emphatic exclamation of agreement, meaning I know that already.

clue.text: Made in imitation of some items in jeweller's at Zermatt

indicators.note: only some of the letters in the following words are used, the run hidden across them

explanation.surface: Fake goods made to imitate items sold in a jeweller's in Zermatt.
explanation.walkthrough: Zermatt is a Swiss ski resort.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an artificial substitute, like fake coffee, is a poor imitation.

clue.text: Refinement shown by French resort type? Not half!

parts.note: Nice is a resort on the French Riviera

indicators.note: not half means only half of type is kept, its first two letters

explanation.surface: Refined manners shown by a type at a French resort, emphatically.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not half!' looks like a British exclamation meaning very much, but it cuts type in half.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a fine distinction or subtle detail is a refinement.

clue.text: Porter, say, in company with male model

parts.note: a poser is someone who poses, as a model does

explanation.surface: A hotel porter keeps company with a male model.
explanation.walkthrough: Porter is Cole Porter, the American songwriter, not a hotel doorman.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Cole Porter wrote songs and musicals, so he is a writer of music.

clue.text: Flower sprang up

definitions.meaning: the past tense of rise, to get up

explanation.surface: A flower shot up.
explanation.definitionFit: A fragrant prickly garden bloom; also the past tense of rise.

clue.text: Resolve of detectives diving into river

indicators.note: diving into means going inside the river word

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, British detectives

explanation.surface: Detectives show determination by plunging into a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Resolve' looks like a noun but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to settle or make up one's mind is to resolve.

clue.text: Decline work supporting doctor

indicators.note: in a down clue, the piece doing the supporting sits below, so the work word comes second

parts.note: op is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: A doctor turns down a job backing someone up.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a fall or decrease is a decline.

clue.text: Witness a time trial

parts.note: a test is a trial

explanation.surface: A witness in a time trial.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to bear witness or vouch for something is to confirm it formally.

clue.text: Allow penalty

definitions.meaning: a punishment imposed for breaking a rule

explanation.surface: Permit a penalty.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both official permission and a punitive measure, a famous contranym.
